observed_validation.failing_test: v641-v4 equation lineage and mutation rebuild

trigger_preconditions: text artifact is checked out with LF bytes
legacy lineage builder hashes raw checkout bytes
stored lineage artifact was generated from CRLF bytes
recovery: Declare the lineage source-hash domain as LF-normalized UTF-8 text bytes, use the existing normalization helper, and regenerate the stored lineage receipt in that same domain.
recurrence_guard: Every portable text-content hash must name and use one logical newline-normalized domain; reserve exact Git-blob hashing for manifests that explicitly attest committed bytes.
promotion_effect: The failed 636/637 clone result remains negative evidence and is not promoted; only a later complete clean-clone pass may close this portability defect.
boundary: This is a text-hash portability negative, not empirical confirmation, security certification, legal or cultural authority, identity evidence, or independent reproduction.
